leaves.doc: gt-x6facts: the three elliptic CM pairs (CM by Z[i], Z[zeta3], Z[sqrt-6]) exist over Qbar (Eichler optimal embeddings; Shimura 1967 sections 1-3 with Shimura-Taniyama descent; Gonzalez-Rotger 2006 Prop. 5.6; locators UNVERIFIED). With elkiesEquationsX6Ab replaces babaGranathRationalAb.
leaves.source: Shimura 1967 sections 1-3 (A_tau at the fixed point of an optimally embedded order), descended to Qbar; Gonzalez-Rotger 2006 Prop. 5.6 (#CM(R) = 2^b h(R) > 0); locators UNVERIFIED
